Karnataka Food Safety Seizes ₹1.38 Crore of Expired, Mislabelled Food in Bengaluru

The Karnataka state food safety department conducted a raid in Bengaluru, confiscating food items that were past their expiry dates and incorrectly labelled. The seized items were valued at approximately ₹1.38 crore. The raid targeted products sold through Amazon and Instamart outlets. Officials said the seizure was part of routine checks to enforce food safety standards. No arrests or further legal action were reported in the coverage.
